value.rationale: The primary source singles out two-block alternating minimization as an acceleration-friendly case and describes extension beyond special structures as difficult. The new theorem isolates a precise mechanism behind that divide: two blocks remain stable across the entire natural momentum interval, whereas three blocks generate complex sweep eigenvalues and a sharp algebraic instability region. The complete boundary is a natural adversarial benchmark for cyclic acceleration, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a mere recomputation of an already-tabulated rate.
